question: Is the one-time full cost-history rebuild caused by bumping all affected cache artifacts acceptable for this upgrade?
rationale: Rebuilding safely prevents reuse of offsets that may have consumed incomplete tails, but its impact on large histories is not demonstrated and choosing narrower invalidation requires subsystem-owner judgment.

options.title: Accept Versioned Rebuild
options.body: Keep the cache-version bumps and require live upgrade proof showing the rebuild completes with acceptable time and resource use.

options.title: Narrow Invalidation
options.body: Preserve unaffected provider caches and invalidate only artifacts whose persisted offsets can exhibit the incomplete-tail behavior.

options.title: Pause For Migration Design
options.body: Hold the PR until a bounded rebuild or explicit offset-migration strategy is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept Versioned Rebuild
recommendation.body: Keep the cache-version bumps and require live upgrade proof showing the rebuild completes with acceptable time and resource use.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work most directly owns incremental cost scanning and cache reuse behavior.
